decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already extends the unchanged AXP2101 power-path behavior to the integrated-board context.
The existing same-message MODIFY already applies battery electrical protection to the integrated board, and the source does not change its protection rules.
The existing same-message MODIFY already adds the integrated-board context; the source does not necessarily remove or alter the external charge-status interface.
The existing same-message MODIFY already changes 3.3V measurement coverage to the integrated board and adds the corresponding scope context.
The existing same-message MODIFY already extends the unchanged AXP2101 thermal-pad requirement to the integrated-board design.
The existing same-message MODIFY already supplies the integrated-board scope; eliminating interboard connectors does not eliminate the external battery connector or resolve its pin-order ambiguity.
The existing MODIFY adds integrated-board scope but leaves obsolete routes through interboard connectors, which the source explicitly eliminates.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I was thinking, if you have time for a new project and are willing to do it, that we try to make as cheap as possible single board for this project. So everything will be on one board and from start we try to match JLCPCB Basica component (as much as possible). It will have much less connectors as there are no interboard connectors. Also if you have some idea on how to make something better/cheaper but have same functionality you can suggest. I can add it as new milestone to this project and we can agree on price. What do you think does it make sense?

decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already updates the DCDC1 role and voltage-compensation description for the integrated-board architecture.
The existing same-message MODIFY moves the connector to the integrated board and removes the obsolete interboard PWRON tap description.
The existing same-message MODIFY records elimination of interboard connectors, removes their obsolete orientation, and changes scope to integrated-board connector access.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the JLCPCB Basic-component preference and integrated-board sourcing scope without invalidating the remaining BOM rules.
The existing MODIFY removes the obsolete separate-board activation condition but fails to update the regulator's board location from the main board to the integrated board.
